cues.en: Hello, my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on AWS CodeBuild.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 AWS CodeBuild 實作。

cues.en: After CodePipeline, now is the time to cover CodeBuild, which is a fully managed continuous integration service of AWS where you can build and test code.
cues.zh: CodePipeline 之後，介紹 CodeBuild，全受管持續整合服務，可建置、測試程式。

cues.en: And speaking of which, that's exactly what we're gonna do in this hands-on tutorial.
We're gonna build a machine learning model using CodeBuild more specifically, a linear regression model, alright?
cues.zh: 使用 CodeBuild 建機器學習模型，更具體是線性迴歸。

cues.en: So it's gonna be exciting.
We're actually gonna implement this from scratch.
And so here we go.
Let's go to the search bar.
Let's enter CodeBuild, which remember for the exam is a fully managed continuous integration service to indeed build and test code.
cues.zh: 輸入 CodeBuild，考試記得是全受管持續整合，建置、測試程式。

cues.en: So here we go.
Welcome to AWS CodeBuild.
This is indeed the welcome page and our first step will be to create a new project.
cues.zh: 這是歡迎頁，第一步建新專案。

cues.en: Alright, so what name should we give to our project?
Well, let's keep things simple.
Let's call it machine learning, all right?
Because we're gonna build a machinery model.
Then you can choose between a default project type, where you can create a custom CodeBuild project, which is exactly what we're gonna do.
cues.zh: 可選 Default project，自訂 CodeBuild，正是要做的。

cues.en: Or a runner project where you can create a CodeBuild managed runner for workflows in GitHub Actions, GitHub Enterprise Actions, GitLab or Buildkite.
cues.zh: 或 Runner project，為 GitHub Actions、GitHub Enterprise Actions、GitLab、Buildkite 工作流程提供受管 runner。

cues.en: Okay, so let's go back to default project.
We're gonna customize different things here.
So first, just as with CodePipeline, you can choose a source or actually no source, but if we look at the different sources, you will see that they are the same as in CodePipeline
cues.zh: 像 CodePipeline，可選來源，也可 No source。來源大致相同，

cues.en: except for S3, okay?
S3 was not in CodePipeline, but you have GitHub, GitHub Enterprise Server, Bitbucket, GitLab, GitLab Self Managed, and AWS CodeCommit also, okay?
cues.zh: CodePipeline 剛沒列 S3，這裡還有 GitHub、GitHub Enterprise Server、Bitbucket、GitLab、GitLab Self-managed、CodeCommit。

cues.en: So for us, we're actually gonna choose no source because I prepared a Python code for you which builds from scratch, a linear regression model with some dummy data just to keep things simple.
cues.zh: 這裡選 No source，因為準備了 Python 程式，用簡單假資料從頭建線性迴歸。

cues.en: And we will build and run this machine learning model implementation within CodeBuild, okay?
cues.zh: 在 CodeBuild 建置並執行模型實作。

cues.en: So after choosing the source or no source, well, you have to configure the environment.
cues.zh: 選完來源或無來源，設定環境。

cues.en: You can choose between on-demand or reserved capacity, just like with EC2 instances.
cues.zh: 可 On-demand 或 Reserved capacity，類似 EC2。

cues.en: So on-demand will automatically provision build infrastructure in response to new builds as you need the resources.
cues.zh: On-demand 在新建置需要時，自動佈建基礎設施。

cues.en: Whereas with reserved capacity, you will use a dedicated fleet of instances for builds and a fleet's compute and environment type will be used for the project, okay?
cues.zh: Reserved capacity 使用專屬執行個體機群，專案採用機群運算、環境類型。

cues.en: So it's the same difference as between on-demand EC2 instances and reserved EC2 instances Okay, so of course, let's choose on-demand.
cues.zh: 講者比喻為隨需與預留 EC2 的差別，當然選 On-demand。

cues.en: And then you have the choice between a managed environment image or a custom image where you specify actually a docker image.
cues.zh: 再選受管環境映像，或自行指定 Docker 映像。

cues.en: So let's keep managed image, which once again, will be managed by AWS CodeBuild because as we said, CodeBuild is a fully managed CI service, continuous integration service.
cues.zh: 保留受管，AWS CodeBuild 管理，因為是全受管 CI。

cues.en: Then compute, you have the choice between EC2 or Lambda, which remember, is a serverless compute service where the servers are called and running only when you run the code,
cues.zh: Compute 可 EC2 或 Lambda，記得 Lambda 無伺服器，只在執行程式、

cues.en: only when you use them.
So let's go back to EC2.
Then for the running mode, you have the choice between a container where you're gonna run your code on docker container or an EC2 instance directly.
cues.zh: Running mode 可 Docker container，或直接 EC2。

cues.en: Alright, so let's keep container as we've just covered them.
Operating system, you have the choice between Linux, Windows or Ubuntu.
Okay, let's keep Linux.
And runtime, standard, okay?
Then the image, you have the choice between many different images.
Let's keep the standard one, 2.0 version.
It doesn't really matter here, our code is actually very simple.
cues.zh: 這裡不重要，程式很簡單。

cues.en: Image version, always use the latest image for this runtime version.
cues.zh: Image version，總是用該執行版本最新映像。

cues.en: Yes, okay, that's good.
Now, service role, of course, you're gonna need an IAM role to run your code through CodeBuild.
cues.zh: Service role，當然需 IAM 角色才能透過 CodeBuild 執行。

cues.en: And since we don't have an existing service role, we're gonna create a new one, which will be named this one, okay?
cues.zh: 沒有現有角色，建新的，名稱這個。

cues.en: And now finally, Buildspec.
Yes, because we didn't choose any source provider, we selected no source.
cues.zh: 因為沒有選來源，選 No source。

cues.en: So we have to actually include our Python code that builds and trains the machinery model, the linear irrigation model inside the build commands, okay?
cues.zh: 所以必須把建立、訓練線性迴歸模型的 Python 放在建置指令。

cues.en: And actually here, we're gonna switch to the editor so that we can include our Python code here, but actually in a YAML file.
cues.zh: 切換編輯器，把 Python 放這裡，但格式是 YAML。

cues.en: And so that's exactly what I've prepared for you in your AWS YAML folder.
cues.zh: AWS 課程資源資料夾有準備。

cues.en: More specifically, in the section four machine learning workflow automation CI/CD pipelines.
cues.zh: 第四節 Machine Learning Workflow Automation CI/CD Pipelines。

cues.en: There it is, linear regression, okay?
The CodeBuilds a linear regression model.
cues.zh: 這份 CodeBuild 程式建立線性迴歸。

cues.en: So let's open this with a text editor.
I'm on Sublime Text here, but it can be any.
cues.zh: 我用 Sublime Text，任何編輯器都可。

cues.en: And as you see, first it's in YAML format, but inside, you have indeed the Python code that builds and trains the linear regression model.
cues.zh: 外面 YAML，裡面 Python 建立、訓練線性迴歸。

cues.en: So first, we define the data.
So it's dummy data where in each pair here, the first element is the input, and the second element is the output, or more specifically, the first element is the feature,
cues.zh: 假資料，每對第一個輸入、第二輸出，更具體是第一個特徵，

cues.en: and the second element is the target.
So for one, we have two.
For two, we have four, for three, we have six, for four, we have eight, for five, we have 10.
And of course, for six, we'll have 12.
Okay, so it's really dummy data, but that's just for educational purposes so that we can check the correct prediction at the end, okay?
cues.zh: 很簡單假資料，只為教學，最後確認正確預測。

cues.en: Then this linear regression model is built and trained from scratch.
cues.zh: 線性迴歸從頭建立、訓練。

cues.en: So first we initialize the weight, the learning rate of open 0.01.
We do a little print to say that the training is starting.
And then we do the for loop that will train the linear regression model through gradient descent, of course.
cues.zh: for 迴圈用梯度下降訓練。

cues.en: So that's exactly what we do here.
Here we compute the gradient, which is indeed the derivative of the means squared error with respect to the weight.
cues.zh: 計算梯度，均方誤差對權重的導數。

cues.en: And then we apply gradient descent underweight, meaning that we subtract the previous weight by the learning rate multiplied by the gradient, okay?
cues.zh: 再更新權重，前一權重減學習率乘梯度。

cues.en: So that's gradient descent.
Always good to know that especially for interviews.
It won't really happen at the exam, but still it's really good to know a little bit about gradient descent.
cues.zh: 考試不太會問，但稍微理解很好。

cues.en: And then we print that the training is finished at the end of the for loop.
We print the learned weight and finally, we print the prediction for the input feature value of six, which of course, will be 12, okay?
cues.zh: 印學到的權重，最後印特徵 6 的預測，當然是 12。

cues.en: So we'll actually check that when the code has finished to run within CodeBuild, okay?
And finally, it's gonna run the ML script and we actually create this linear regression, that PY python file, which will be in a temporary container as we run the code within CodeBuild.
cues.zh: 最後執行 ML 腳本，建立 linear_regression.py，放在 CodeBuild 執行時的暫存容器。

cues.en: And at the end of course, we'll do the cleanup.
So those temporary containers will all be deleted and gone.
Okay, great.
So now let's select this whole code.
Let's copy it and then back to AWS CodeBuild.
Well, we're gonna remove everything here and paste this whole code, okay?
Let's check below that there are no errors, neither any warning.
Perfect, 0, 0.
Great.
As you can see, it's in the YAML format.
And then that's it.
Then you can configure some artifacts, but we'll choose to have no artifact and the logs.
cues.zh: Artifacts 可設定，但選 No artifacts；再看日誌。

cues.en: The logs are gonna be important because this is the only way we can check our prints, you know, with the final prediction.
cues.zh: 日誌重要，唯一能確認 print、最後預測的方式。

cues.en: So we have to keep the logs and we'll have them in CloudWatch logs.
But optionally, just so you know, you can also have them in S3, S3 logs, okay?
But CloudWatch is perfect and we will have it directly actually in the CodeBuilder console.
cues.zh: 但 CloudWatch 很好，實際可直接在 CodeBuild 主控台看。

cues.en: So here we go.
Are you ready?
Let's click create build project.
Okay, perfect.
Now it's creating the build project.
It's gonna take just a few seconds and in a few seconds, we'll have our project well built and then we'll need to start it.
cues.zh: 只需幾秒，建好後還要啟動。

cues.en: You know, we'll need to start building right here, as you can see, right?
We haven't run the code here, we just built the code within CodeBuild.
cues.zh: 尚未執行，只設定好 CodeBuild 專案。

cues.en: But now in order to run it and train our linear regression model, we have to click this button indeed, start build.
cues.zh: 要真正執行、訓練線性迴歸，按 Start build。

cues.en: Indeed if we scroll down here, there is nothing in the history yet, as you can see.
So let's do this.
Are you ready?
Here we go.
3, 2, 1, and start build.
Now the code is running and now the model is training.
The linear regression model is training.
As you can see, status in progress.
It's only gonna take a few seconds because of course, it's a very simple model and very simple data.
cues.zh: 只需幾秒，因為模型與資料都很簡單。

cues.en: And in a few seconds, we'll have, there you go, succeeded.
Perfect.
So all good here.
It worked successfully.
And now let's scroll down to check our final prediction in the logs, of course, as I was telling you, build logs.
cues.zh: 往下在日誌查看最終預測，Build logs。

cues.en: So this is actually coming from CloudWatch logs.
And if we scroll down, well, we have of course, the whole process, you know, with the different steps that were successful.
cues.zh: 往下，有完整流程與成功步驟。

cues.en: And there you go, building a linear regression model.
And if we scroll down, we have, well, our Python code, and if we scroll down more, we have our first print running ML script and then starting training, then training finished,
cues.zh: 再往下有 Python 程式，繼續有第一個輸出 Running ML script、Starting training、Training finished，

cues.en: then the learned weight is 2.0.
And finally, the prediction for an input value, meaning a feature value of six, x = 6.
cues.zh: 最後輸入特徵 x = 6 的預測，

cues.en: We get indeed a prediction of 12.
Perfect.
So it worked successfully.
We successfully just used AWS CodeBuild to first automatically spin up a managed build environment in the cloud, then run our own Python script
cues.zh: 成功用 CodeBuild，自動啟動雲端受管建置環境，再跑自己的 Python，

cues.zh: 不需管理伺服器，因為全受管。

cues.en: Then we executed a mini machine learning training job fully in AWS.
cues.zh: 接著完全在 AWS 執行小型 ML 訓練。

cues.zh: 最後理解機器學習專案持續整合核心。

Delete builds.
